cd /var/www/maestro-studio && python3 -c "import os,json,base64,zlib,subprocess; p = ""; data = json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(p)).decode('utf-8')); for path, content in data.items():;     d = os.path.dirname(path);     if d and not os.path.exists(d): os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True);     with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(content);     print(f"  ✓ {path}"); print("📦 npm install..."); subprocess.run(["npm", "install"], check=True); print("🔨 npm run build..."); subprocess.run(["npm", "run", "build"], check=True); print("🔄 pm2 restart..."); subprocess.run(["pm2", "restart", "maestro-studio"], check=False); subprocess.run(["pm2", "restart", "all"], check=False); print("✅ AGGIORNAMENTO COMPLETATO!")"
